title: Tech Note: Query Expansion using Simple Edit
author: Timothy Tse, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: The edit-distance algorithm itself is a timeless, language-agnostic technique (still the basis of modern fuzzy search/autocorrect); the 4D implementation using classic ARRAY commands still runs today, though contemporary 4D code would likely use collections instead of arrays, and production fuzzy-search needs are often now offloaded to a full-text search engine (e.g., Elasticsearch) rather than 4D-side edit-distance generation.
